title: Page 9
content_zh:
“我还是适合一个人吧！”言待榆如此的告诉自己。
“你确定要放弃他了吗？”罗曼曼怀疑的问。
“我这不叫放弃，而是叫顺其自然，人呢是不能太强求的。”就像她没办法回应林颜强的感情一样。
“那让给我好了。”一说完，罗曼曼的脸也跟着发红。
言待榆闻言，霎时睁大了眼，“什么？”
“我觉得殷先生人不错，你不喜欢，就让给我吧！”罗曼曼说得很理所当然。
“你、你怎么会有种想法？”
“上次你不是要我把他吗？”罗曼曼的目光只敢看着地上，“我发现我对他还满有感觉的。”
她看到言待榆发白的脸色，不忘又羞怯的补上一句，“看他长得斯斯文文的，没想到身材却很结实，又很有男人味，我很喜欢。”
怎、怎怎么会这样？才抱一次就有感觉了？“可是……可是你不是有男朋友吗？”
“分手了啊！”罗曼曼腼腆道：“所以我要追他，够义气的话，你不可以阻挡我呦！”
言待榆脑中一片空白，完全说不出话。
“反正你本来就是要把他介绍给我的。”罗曼曼笑道。
“可是……”她不是说跟他不来电吗……
“你不是也说，情人当不成还可以当朋友，你的两个好朋友交往，这样不好吗？说不定殷策也会因此而跟你恢复友谊。”
“我也是这几天才想清楚的，老实说，还真要感谢你呢！”罗曼曼握着言待榆的手贴在自己的脸上，一脸梦幻少女的模样。
言待榆抖了一身，“我也常说他的缺点啊！”怎么罗曼曼就没跟着讨厌呢？
“我可以包容。”
“我也可以。”言待榆急忙道。
“大鱼，我搞不懂你到底是想怎样？”罗曼曼困惑的看着她。

“曼曼，朋友夫、不可戏！”罗曼曼的这种行为实在是太没义气了。
“都要离婚了……这哪算朋友夫？”
咦？从什么时候开始，罗曼曼竟变得这么讨人厌？“你是真的喜欢他？”
“对啊！”罗曼曼说完，心虚的移开视线，深怕被看出来似的又急忙道：“你会让给我吧？”
“让？”言待榆倒抽一口气——罗曼曼怎么会用如此邪恶的字眼！
“不过我也会努力地，我已经打电话给他，跟他约了中午一起吃饭。”
“你约他中午一起吃午饭？”言待榆忍不住扬高音调。
“对啊！我等一下就要过去了。”罗曼曼拿出镜子，整理着头发。
“我也要去！”言待榆想也不想的道。
言待榆见到殷策真的出现，脑袋只觉得一片空白——他、他该不会是真的要跟罗曼曼交往了吧？记得之前他才搂着她说什么只想追她一人，现在罗曼曼一约他就出来，这到底是怎么回事？
“你怎么也来了？”殷策看了言待榆一眼，立即将视线放在罗曼曼身上，“你等很久了吧？”
“没有，我们也才刚到。”罗曼曼甜笑。
言待榆看着殷策对待她的态度很冷淡，心里有点受伤，“我来是要谢谢你的帮忙，曼曼不生我的气了。”
“举手之劳。”殷策看着罗曼曼，“再说，看曼曼伤心，我也很难过。”
他竟然在她面前对着罗曼曼说这么恶心的话？言待榆气闷的低着头，很想揍人。
“你们两人看起来好生疏。”罗曼曼故意戳着言待榆的瘪处，“快点餐吧！这家餐厅我常来。”她拿起MENU认真的对殷策介绍，“这家的套餐都有附有香槟，你可以试试招牌套餐——”
言待榆看着他们两人热络的讨论，觉得自己被晾在一旁——她的好友和前男友聊得开心，她应该是要感到高兴的，但她就是觉得心酸得好想哭。
餐点送上桌，言待榆索然无味的吃着，还在为罗曼曼的心意感到慌乱。
第10章(2)
“殷大哥，你吃看看口味合不合？”罗曼曼用汤匙舀了一口豆腐要喂他。

“谢谢。”殷策低头吃了一口。
言待榆忍不住多看了罗曼曼一眼——曼曼今天还真是格外积极，但让她更惊讶的是，她以为表面正直的殷策会假意推拒，结果他让曼曼喂着。
真是个没有节操的男人！
“曼曼，你多吃一点。”殷策温柔的夹着菜，“你太瘦了。”
“咳，曼曼，你不是要减肥吗？”言待榆咳了一声警告着，上个月才跟她鬼哭神号说手臂胖了两圈的人是谁？
“可是……殷大哥希望我再胖一点。”罗曼曼笑得很害羞，心里很担心自己是否能全身而退？
“我呢？”言待榆问道，不知自己在他心中，身材是否算是标准？
“你少吃一点，太壮了。”他淡淡的瞄她一眼道。
“壮才好！”她气得瞪着他，这人心爱得还真快，这不就嫌她壮了？她这叫健康！
“殷大哥，你也多吃一点，吃得和我一样壮，才配得上我。”言待榆也夹了肉给他。
殷策低下头，偷偷的扬起嘴角，好心情的看着言待榆吃醋的样子。
“殷大哥，你明天有没有空？”罗曼曼冒死询问。
“嗯？”
“我想说可以约你来我家玩。”
“好啊！”殷策淡淡的一笑。
“去你家想干嘛？”言待榆皱眉问着罗曼曼。
罗曼曼很害羞的在她耳边小声道：“都来我家了，还能干嘛——”
轰——言待榆只觉得自己的脑门就快爆开了。
“大鱼，你怎么了？”
言待榆狠狠地瞪着殷策，“不准去！”

“为什么？”殷策反问。
“别忘了，还没离婚，你还是我的人！”她不是滋味的看着他们亲密的模样，被排斥在外的感觉很糟，原来她的心眼竟然这么小，她根本就没办法大方的祝福他们两人。
“大鱼，如果不喜欢，就快点放手。”罗曼曼说得胆怯。
“谁不喜欢了？”她恶声恶气的对着罗曼曼说完后，又瞪向殷策，“你给我过来！”粗鲁的拉着他走。
“你要去哪里？”罗曼曼急着问道：“饭还没吃完。”
“我要和他谈一谈，待会儿回来！”
罗曼曼看着好友拉着殷策急忙离开，这才悠哉的大快朵颐着桌上的美味料理。
确定四周没有闲杂人等，言待榆停下脚步，转身看向殷策。
“你有什么事吗？”他不解的问，心里还在为她刚才那句“谁不喜欢”的话感到愉悦。
“你喜欢罗曼曼吗？如果你是真的喜欢她，那我就成全你们。”她痛下决心道，君子有成人之美，大不了她心痛个几天就好。
“你不是喜欢我吗？”他的嘴角抽搐了一下，她到底是在想什么？
“所以我问你喜不喜欢罗曼曼，我不要勉强来的爱情。”
“我喜欢的一直是你。”
“我当然知道你——”她怔了一会儿，一时说不出话来。
“傻了？”他揉揉她的头发，“我喜欢的人是你。”
“那、那你刚才和罗曼曼是怎么一回事？”她以为他们也许是郎有情、妹有意，所以她才会想痛心成全。
“我跟她只是朋友。”他说得很正直。
“那我说要重新开始，你为什么不肯？”她听到她的话语，没有开心，只有更多的疑虑。“我不要离婚。”
“什么？”
“我说我不想跟你离婚，而和重新开始又太浪费时间了。”

“那你干嘛提？”她瞪向他。
“因为那时我很生气。”他学到教训了，以后无论再怎么生气，都不能轻易提出离婚——要让这女人主动要求复合实在是太难了。“我在等待机会跟你说清楚。”
content_en:
"I'm still suitable for being alone!" Yan Daiyu told himself.
"Are you sure you want to give up on him?" Romanman asked suspiciously.
"I don't call this giving up, I call it letting nature take its course. People can't force things too hard." It was like she couldn't respond to Lin Yanqiang's feelings.
"Then leave it to me." As soon as he finished speaking, Romanman's face turned red.
When Yan Zaiyu heard this, his eyes widened in an instant, "What?"
"I think Mr. Yin is a nice person. If you don't like him, just leave it to me!" Roman Man said matter-of-factly.
"How come you have such an idea?"
"Didn't you ask me to get him last time?" Roman Man only dared to look at the ground, "I found that I still have feelings for him."
When she saw Yan Daiyu's pale face, she did not forget to add timidly, "Looking at him, he looks elegant, but I didn't expect that he has a strong figure and is very masculine. I like him very much."
How, how could this happen? Did you feel it after just being hugged once? "But...but don't you have a boyfriend?"
"We broke up!" Roman Man said shyly, "That's why I want to chase him. If you are loyal enough, you can't stop me!"
Yan Daiyu's mind went blank and he was completely speechless.
"Anyway, you were going to introduce him to me." Romanman smiled.
"But..." Didn't she say she wouldn't call him...
"Didn't you also say that if you can't be lovers, you can still be friends? Isn't this good for your two good friends to date? Maybe Yin Ce will restore friendship with you because of this."
"I only figured it out in the past few days. To be honest, I really want to thank you!" Romanman held Yan Taiyu's hand and put it against his face, looking like a dreamy girl.
Yan Daiyu trembled, "I often talk about his shortcomings!" Why didn't Luo Manman hate him too?
"I can be tolerant."
"I can do that too." Yan Daiyu said hurriedly.
"Big Fish, I don't understand what you want?" Romanman looked at her in confusion.
"Manman, you can't play with your friend's husband!" Romanman's behavior was really unfaithful.
"We're about to get divorced... How can this be considered a friend's husband?"
Huh? Since when did Roman Man become so annoying? "Do you really like him?"
"That's right!" After Romanman finished speaking, he looked away guiltily and said hurriedly, as if he was afraid of being seen out, "Will you let me?"
"Let?" Yan Taiyu gasped - how could Luo Manman use such evil words!
"But I will work hard. I have already called him and made an appointment with him to have lunch together."
"You asked him to have lunch together?" Yan Taiyu couldn't help but raise his voice.
"Yes! I'll be there soon." Romanman took out the mirror and arranged his hair.
"I want to go too!" Yan Daiyu said without even thinking about it.
When Yan Daiyu saw Yin Ce actually showing up, his head went blank - he, he was really going to date Luo Manman, right? I remember he hugged her before and said he only wanted to chase her, but now he comes out as soon as Romanman asks him out. What is going on?
"Why are you here too?" Yin Ce glanced at Yan Daiyu and immediately turned his attention to Romanman, "Have you been waiting for a long time?"
"No, we just arrived." Romanman smiled sweetly.
Yan Taiyu felt a little hurt when she saw Yin Ce's cold attitude towards her, "I'm here to thank you for your help. Manman is not angry with me anymore."
"It takes a little effort." Yin Ce looked at Romanman, "Besides, it makes me sad to see Manman sad."
He actually said such disgusting words to Romanman in front of her? Yan Taiyu lowered his head in frustration, wanting to hit someone.
"You two look so unfamiliar." Romanman deliberately poked Yan Taiyu's weak spot, "Hurry up and order your meal! I come to this restaurant often." She picked up the MENU and introduced it to Yin Ce seriously, "This restaurant has all the set meals.Comes with champagne, you can try the signature set——"
Yan Taiyu watched the heated discussion between the two of them and felt that she was being left aside - her friend and her ex-boyfriend were having a happy chat, so she should be happy, but she just felt so sad that she wanted to cry.
The meal was delivered to the table, and Yan Daiyu ate it without any taste, still feeling flustered by Roman Man's thoughts.
Chapter 10(2)
"Brother Yin, try it and see if it tastes good to you? "Romanman took a mouthful of tofu with a spoon and wanted to feed him.
"Thank you. "Yin Ce lowered his head and took a bite.
Yan Taiyu couldn't help but take another look at Romanman - Manman was really very positive today, but what surprised her even more was that she thought that Yin Ce, who seemed upright on the surface, would pretend to refuse, but in the end he let Manman feed him.
What a man without moral integrity!
"Manman, eat more. Yin Ce gently picked up the vegetables and said, "You are too thin." "
“Ahem, Manman, don’t you want to lose weight? Yan Daiyu coughed and warned. Who was the person who told her last month that she had gained two circles of fat on her arms?
"But...brother Yin wants me to be fatter. "Romanman smiled shyly, and was worried about whether he could escape unscathed?
"What about me? Yan Taiyu asked, wondering if his figure was considered a standard in his mind?
"Eat less, you are too strong. "He glanced at her lightly and said.
"It's good to be strong! "She glared at him angrily. This person falls in love so quickly. Doesn't this mean she's too strong? She's called healthy!
"Brother Yin, you should also eat more. Eat until you are as strong as me, so that you are worthy of me. " Yan Daiyu also gave him some meat.
Yin Ce lowered his head, secretly raised the corners of his mouth, and looked at Yan Taiyu's jealous look in a good mood.
"Brother Yin, are you free tomorrow? "Romanman asked risking his life.
"Huh? "
"I want to ask you to come to my house. "
"OK! "Yin Ce smiled faintly.
"What do you want to do at your house? Yan Daiyu frowned and asked Luo Manman.
Romanman shyly whispered in her ear: "You've already come to my house, what else can you do-"
Boom - Yan Taiyu felt that his head was about to explode.
“Big Fish, what’s wrong with you? "
Yan Daiyu glared at Yin Ce, "You're not allowed to go! "
"Why? "Yin Ce asked back.
"Don't forget, before the divorce, you are still mine! "She couldn't help but look at their intimate appearance. She felt bad about being excluded. It turned out that her mind was so small, and she couldn't bless them both generously.
“Big fish, if you don’t like it, let it go quickly. "Romanman said timidly.
"Who doesn't like it? "After she said angrily to Romanman, she glared at Yin Ce, "Come here! "Tuging him away roughly.
"Where are you going? Romanman asked anxiously: "The meal is not finished yet." "
“I want to talk to him and come back later! "
Romanman watched his friend pull Yin Ce away in a hurry, and then leisurely ate the delicious food on the table.
After making sure that there were no other people around, Yan Zaiyu stopped and turned to look at Yin Ce.
"What's the matter with you? " He asked in confusion, still feeling happy about her words "Who doesn't like it" just now?
"Do you like Roman Man? If you really like her, then I will help you. "She made up her mind and said, a gentleman has the beauty of an adult, at worst she will be heartbroken for a few days.
"Don't you like me? "The corners of his mouth twitched. What on earth was she thinking?
"So I ask you if you like Roman Man, I don't want love that is forced. "
"I've always liked you. "
"Of course I know you-" She was stunned for a moment and was speechless.
"Silly? He rubbed her hair and said, "The person I like is you." "
"Then, what happened between you and Roman Man just now? "She thought they might be interested in each other, that's why she wanted to grieve.Complete.
"She and I are just friends." He said honestly.
"Then I said I wanted to start over, why didn't you refuse?" When she heard her words, she was not happy, only more doubtful. "I don't want a divorce."
"What?"
"I said I didn't want to divorce you, and starting over would be a waste of time."
"Then why did you mention it?" She glared at him.
"Because I was very angry at that time." He learned his lesson. No matter how angry he was in the future, he could not easily propose a divorce - it was too difficult for this woman to take the initiative to ask for reconciliation. "I'm waiting for the opportunity to make it clear to you."
